title: Altered stereostructures of the DNA-binding domains in the mutant mating proteins of Ophiocordyceps sinensis and the Cordyceps sinensis insect‒fungal complex
authors: Xiu-Zhang Li; Yu-Ling Li; Jia-Shi Zhu
one_liner_zh: 该文利用AlphaFold结构预测分析冬虫夏草突变交配蛋白DNA结合域的三维结构变异，虽聚焦TF相关HMG-box结构域与DNA结合，但缺乏直接互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，属于广义蛋白-DNA结合域结构研究，对本课题有参考价值。
abstract: The MATα_HMGbox and HMG-box_ROX1-like domains of the MAT1-1-1 and MAT1-2-1 proteins, respectively, play essential roles in DNA binding and the downstream regulation of gene transcription that controls sexual reproduction in Ophiocordyceps sinensis . Alternative splicing, differential occurrence and transcription of the MAT1-1-1 and MAT1-2-1 genes have been revealed in Hirsutella sinensis (Genotype #1 of the 17 O. sinensis genotypes), suggesting the occurrence of self-sterility under heterothallic or hybrid outcrossing. This study demonstrates that the MATα_HMGbox domains of MAT1-1-1 proteins in wild-type Cordyceps sinensis isolates cluster into 5 clades with or without branches in the Bayesian clustering tree and belong to diverse 3D structural morphs under 19 AlphaFold codes. The HMG-box_ROX1-like domains of MAT1-2-1 proteins cluster into 2 clades with branches in the Bayesian clustering tree and belong to diverse 3D structural morphs under 25 AlphaFold codes. Correlation analysis reveals that 1−3 amino acid substitutions at various sites in the DNA-binding domains of the mutant mating proteins result in alterations in the hydrophobicity and the secondary and tertiary structures of the DNA-binding domains of the proteins. Fungal origin analysis reveals heterospecific fungal sources or genome-independent, genotypic sources of the mating proteins with stereostructure variations in the wild-type C. sinensis isolates that represent the changed functionalities of the proteins in regulating and ensuring the accuracy and genetic diversity of the heterothallic and hybrid sexual reproductive processes of O. sinensis during the lifecycle of the C. sinensis insect‒fungi complex.
abstract_zh: MAT1-1-1和MAT1-2-1蛋白的MATα_HMGbox和HMG-box_ROX1-like结构域，分别在与DNA结合及下游调控基因转录中发挥关键作用，这些过程控制着冬虫夏草（Ophiocordyceps sinensis）的有性生殖。在Hirsutella sinensis（17种O. sinensis基因型中的基因型#1）中，已揭示MAT1-1-1和MAT1-2-1基因的选择性剪接、差异出现及转录，提示在异宗配合或杂交异型杂交下存在自交不育性。本研究证明，野生型冬虫夏草（Cordyceps sinensis）分离株中MAT1-1-1蛋白的MATα_HMGbox结构域在贝叶斯聚类树中聚为5个分支（有或无分支），并在19个AlphaFold代码下属于多样的3D结构形态。MAT1-2-1蛋白的HMG-box_ROX1-like结构域在贝叶斯聚类树中聚为2个带分支的类群，并在25个AlphaFold代码下属于多样的3D结构形态。相关性分析揭示，突变交配蛋白DNA结合域中不同位点的1−3个氨基酸替换，导致蛋白DNA结合域的疏水性及二级和三级结构发生改变。真菌来源分析揭示，在野生型C. sinensis分离株中，交配蛋白具有异种真菌来源或基因组独立的基因型来源，并伴随立体结构变异，这些变异代表了蛋白在调控和确保O. sinensis异宗配合及杂交有性生殖过程的准确性和遗传多样性方面的功能变化，该过程发生在C. sinensis昆虫-真菌复合体的生命周期中。
